scenes.title: Opening Title
scenes.vo_text: Introducing the Neurosymbolic XR Framework—a breakthrough in Extended Reality AI that combines the power of deep learning with logical reasoning.

scenes.title: Architecture Overview
scenes.vo_text: The framework features a layered architecture. Sensors feed into neural networks for perception, which are grounded into symbolic representations for reasoning. This bidirectional bridge enables both bottom-up understanding and top-down validation.

scenes.title: System 1: Spatial Reasoning
scenes.vo_text: System One: Spatial Reasoning. We capture the scene with 3D Gaussian Splatting, segment objects with SAM 2, and ground them to language with CLIP. The result? A queryable scene graph that understands both geometry and semantics.

scenes.title: System 2: Hybrid SLAM
scenes.vo_text: System Two: Hybrid SLAM. Visual-inertial tracking provides precise localization at 60 frames per second. But unlike traditional SLAM, we maintain semantic memory—objects are remembered across sessions, building a persistent understanding of the environment.

scenes.title: System 3: VR Training Assistant
scenes.vo_text: System Three: VR Training Assistant. Hand and gaze tracking feed into Prolog-based procedural reasoning. Each action is validated against logical preconditions and constraints, providing real-time feedback to guide users through complex procedures.

scenes.title: System 4: Neural-Symbolic Asset Generator
scenes.vo_text: System Four: Neural-Symbolic Asset Generator. Natural language descriptions are combined with geometric constraints. Z3 validates feasibility, then Stable Diffusion generates the asset. The result? AI-created content that satisfies both aesthetic and functional requirements.

scenes.title: Poetics Platform Integration
scenes.vo_text: All four systems integrate seamlessly with the Poetics VR platform. A unified API manages sessions, tracks users, stores semantic memory in Supabase, and provides real-time events. Everything you need for intelligent VR experiences.

scenes.title: Performance Metrics
scenes.vo_text: Performance is critical for XR. The framework achieves sub-20 millisecond tracking latency, real-time scene understanding, and fast asset generation—all while running complex AI models.

scenes.title: Technical Stack
scenes.vo_text: Built on cutting-edge technologies: 3D Gaussian Splatting for rendering, SAM 2 for segmentation, CLIP for grounding, and Stable Diffusion for generation. Symbolic reasoning with RDF, Prolog, and Z3. All integrated with Supabase and OpenXR.

scenes.title: Call to Action
scenes.vo_text: Ready to build intelligent VR experiences? The Neurosymbolic XR Framework is open source and production-ready. Visit the GitHub repository for the source code, architecture documentation, and interactive demo. Transform your VR applications with the power of neurosymbolic AI.

scenes.title: Closing
scenes.vo_text: Neurosymbolic XR Framework. The future of intelligent Extended Reality.
